name: universal-engineering-default-gates
description: Portable baseline checks for the Universal Engineering Skill.

rules.description: The skill entry file must have a closed YAML frontmatter block.
Relative Markdown links must point to existing files.
Tracked text must not contain obvious private keys, access tokens or credential assignments.
NOT_RUN, BLOCKED and UNKNOWN evidence cannot be presented as PASS.
Stage evidence must contain required fields and honest status values.
Every machine-readable rule must contain id, severity, scope, check and description.
VERSION and skill-manifest.json must declare the same Skill version; an optional SKILL.md version must agree when present.
